says: Run as volta run --node 26.13.0 pnpm lint, each pnpm sub-script prints that the project requires Node.js 26.13.0 and the current Node.js is v22.22.3, so the lint checks may run on a Node the project says it does not support.
proof: In the ticket 933 build round, pnpm lint printed '[WARN] This project requires Node.js 26.13.0. Your current Node.js is v22.22.3' before code-graph --boundaries, packages/fabrika/browser-check.ts, code-graph --unreachable, compiler.ts, twin.ts and promise-types.ts; the step-commit script's sign call printed the same line.
cost: A check that leans on Node 26 behavior could pass or fail differently here than in CI, which pins 26.13.0.
